# AI-Developer-Ready SRS: Real Estate SaaS MVP (`tf_ord_12266de1765824c5d2`)

## 1. Executive Overview
Next.js 16 + PostgreSQL multi-tenant property management portal

## 2. Architecture Pattern: `modular-monorepo`
- **Frontend:** Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend:** Node.js
- **Database:** PostgreSQL
- **DevOps:** Docker

## 3. Database Models
### Table: `users`
Authenticated application principals and roles.
  - `id`: `uuid` (PK) NOT NULL
  - `email`: `varchar(255)` (UNIQUE) NOT NULL
  - `role`: `varchar(32)` NOT NULL
  - `created_at`: `timestamptz` NOT NULL
  - None
### Table: `records`
Primary domain entity mapped from client specification.
  - `id`: `uuid` (PK) NOT NULL
  - `owner_id`: `uuid` NOT NULL
  - `title`: `varchar(160)` NOT NULL
  - `status`: `varchar(32)` NOT NULL
  - `payload`: `jsonb` NOT NULL
  - `updated_at`: `timestamptz` NOT NULL
  - FK `owner_id` -> `users.id` (ON DELETE CASCADE)

## 4. API Endpoints
| Method | Route | Auth | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Public | Container readiness and database health probe. |
| `GET` | `/api/records` | Required | List paginated domain records owned by the authenticated principal. |
| `POST` | `/api/records` | Required | Validate and persist a new domain record. |

## 5. UI Screens & Routing
### Authentication Gate (`/login`)
- **Components:** CredentialsForm, SessionGuard
- **Interactions:** Authenticate user; Redirect to workspace

### Real Estate SaaS MVP Workspace (`/dashboard`)
- **Components:** SidebarNav, DataTable, RecordModal, StatusBadge
- **Interactions:** Create/edit/delete domain records; Filter and export records

## 6. Milestone Breakdown (25% / 50% / 25%)
- **Day 1: Schema + Boilerplate & Architecture Lock** (25% milestone): Modular monorepo scaffold + Docker configuration; Database migrations, core entities, and auth middleware; Environment template and CI lint/typecheck pipeline
- **Day 4: Staging MVP Delivery** (50% milestone): Core CRUD API endpoints and frontend/mobile screens wired end-to-end; Live staging URL / TestFlight or APK preview build; Automated integration test suite passing in Docker
- **Day 7: Final Release & Repository Handover** (25% milestone): Security audit, performance check, and production build verification; GitHub repository transfer / org invite and deployment runbook; Final handover report and escrow/milestone release

## 7. Automated Acceptance Criteria
- **[AC-01] (database)**: Migrations apply cleanly on an empty database with foreign-key constraints enforced. (`docker compose up -d db && npm run db:migrate`)
- **[AC-02] (api)**: Unauthenticated calls to protected /api/* routes return HTTP 401; valid payloads return HTTP 200/201. (`npm test`)
- **[AC-03] (ui)**: Primary screens render without runtime console errors and complete core create/read flows. (`npm run build`)
- **[AC-04] (ci_cd)**: Production Docker image builds cleanly and passes /api/health smoke check. (`docker build -t app:verify .`)
